# Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct

Meta · released 2024-09 · 10.7B params · llama3.2

**score 42.6** ±1.8 · #647 of 934 · from 11 benchmark results across 4 sources

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

<sub>[context source](https://huggingface.co/meta-llama/Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct/blob/9eb2daaa8597bf192a8b0e73f848f3a102794df5/README.md): Context length stated on the official model card.</sub>

<pre>
download          size  score
4-bit q4_k_m   ~6.92GB   42.6
8-bit q8_0    ~13.34GB   42.6
</pre>

```sh
# 4-bit q4_k_m
ollama run llama3.2-vision:11b-instruct-q4_K_M
# 8-bit q8_0
ollama run llama3.2-vision:11b-instruct-q8_0
```

<sub>The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.</sub>
